description: Tool to mark a Stripe invoice as uncollectible for bad debt accounting purposes. Use when you need to write off an unpaid invoice that is unlikely to be collected.

inputSchema.description: Request model for marking an invoice as uncollectible.

invoice.description: The ID of the invoice to mark as uncollectible. Must start with 'in_' followed by alphanumeric characters.
invoice.title: Invoice

inputSchema.title: MarkInvoiceUncollectibleRequest

name: mark_invoice_uncollectible

MarkInvoiceUncollectibleResponse.description: Response model for an invoice marked as uncollectible.

amount_paid.description: Amount that was paid in cents
amount_paid.title: Amount Paid

amount_remaining.description: Amount remaining to be paid in cents
amount_remaining.title: Amount Remaining

attempted.description: Whether payment was attempted for this invoice
attempted.title: Attempted

auto_advance.description: Whether Stripe automatically finalizes the invoice
auto_advance.title: Auto Advance

collection_method.description: How payment is collected, either 'charge_automatically' or 'send_invoice'
collection_method.title: Collection Method

created.description: Time at which the invoice was created. Unix timestamp in seconds.
created.title: Created

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code in lowercase
currency.title: Currency

customer.description: ID of the customer this invoice belongs to
customer.title: Customer

description.description: An arbitrary string attached to the invoice
description.title: Description

due_date.description: The date on which payment for this invoice is due. Unix timestamp.
due_date.title: Due Date

ending_balance.description: Customer's ending account balance after the invoice was finalized, in cents
ending_balance.title: Ending Balance

hosted_invoice_url.description: URL for the hosted invoice page
hosted_invoice_url.title: Hosted Invoice Url

invoice_pdf.description: URL to download the invoice as a PDF
invoice_pdf.title: Invoice Pdf

livemode.description: True if the object exists in live mode, false if in test mode
livemode.title: Livemode

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs for additional information
metadata.title: Metadata

number.description: Unique sequential number identifying the invoice
number.title: Number

object.description: String representing the object's type. Always 'invoice' for this endpoint.
object.title: Object

period_end.description: End of the usage period covered by the invoice. Unix timestamp.
period_end.title: Period End

period_start.description: Start of the usage period covered by the invoice. Unix timestamp.
period_start.title: Period Start

starting_balance.description: Customer's starting account balance before the invoice was finalized, in cents
starting_balance.title: Starting Balance

status.description: Invoice status. Will be 'uncollectible' for successfully marked invoices.
status.title: Status

status_transitions.description: Timestamps tracking status changes of the invoice
status_transitions.title: Status Transitions

subtotal.description: Total of all invoice item amounts before discounts or taxes, in cents
subtotal.title: Subtotal

subtotal_excluding_tax.description: Subtotal before discounts or taxes, excluding tax amounts, in cents
subtotal_excluding_tax.title: Subtotal Excluding Tax

total.description: Total after discounts and taxes, in cents
total.title: Total

total_excluding_tax.description: Total after discounts but excluding tax amounts, in cents
total_excluding_tax.title: Total Excluding Tax

MarkInvoiceUncollectibleResponse.title: MarkInvoiceUncollectibleResponse

finalized_at.description: Timestamp when the invoice was finalized
finalized_at.title: Finalized At

marked_uncollectible_at.description: Timestamp when the invoice was marked as uncollectible
marked_uncollectible_at.title: Marked Uncollectible At

paid_at.description: Timestamp when the invoice was paid
paid_at.title: Paid At

voided_at.description: Timestamp when the invoice was voided
voided_at.title: Voided At
